_: The alley's roof run, the first round (BRIEF_ADDENDUM D9, D10; Shared/Attractions/AlleyRoof): the yard house and its tree (tools/bake/alley/Yard) beside the eighteen-lane alley's games wing. Local to world: x = 1300 + X, y = 16.5 + Y, z = -420 - D. Groups: 'routes' draws the roof run's routes (yellow the way up, orange the leap's flight with no key, cyan the vent and rafters that have no building yet); 'squirrels' stands the placeholder squirrel where the motor puts one (at the ridge's end, halfway up the gutter, on the bough, past the trunk's top, on the wing roof); 'plan' outlines what is planned or kept, review only: the yard annex (yellow), the backstage reserve (red), lounge one (magenta), the stairs and landings (white), the guard platform's grating (cyan), the people fence (orange), the bare apron at the louvre (green), the vent unit's curb (blue). Render: the bakes, then lune run tools/review/export.luau --out build/review_roof/scene.json; lune run tools/review/alley_roof.luau; render.py --scene build/review_roof/scene.json --views tools/review/views_alley_roof.json --out build/review_roof. Committed pictures: docs/renders/alley_roof/.

views.name: y13_guard_view_to_the_ridge_end
